steps.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import pathlib,json
p=pathlib.Path('/etc/cal/root.json');d=json.loads(p.read_text());d['allow_channels']={'alice':['download']};p.write_text(json.dumps(d))
EOF
calctl apply; cat /var/lib/cal/current.json

pid=$(cat /home/alice/d2/continuation.pid); date -Ins; cat /proc/$pid/status; cat /proc/$pid/attr/current; cat /proc/$pid/stat; readlink /proc/$pid/exe; wc -l /home/alice/d2/markers/continuation-revoke; tail -3 /home/alice/d2/continuation.log
